scanNote: 12-mashqda xarid ro'yxatidagi qaysi band belgilanishi (✓) va qaysisi chizib tashlanishi faqat kassetada aniqlanadi. Kitobda ikkitasi berilgan: 'meat' ✓ va 'eggs' chizib tashlangan. Quyida barcha bandlar uchun savol-javob qolipi berilgan — bu qism audio talab qilmaydi.

sections.title: How Much / How Many — A Few / A Little
sections.titleUz: How Much / How Many — A Few / A Little

exercises.instructionEn: Study the examples and complete the rules, then use the prompts to act out similar dialogues.
exercises.instructionUz: Misollarni o'rganing va qoidalarni to'ldiring, so'ng berilgan so'zlar bilan shunga o'xshash dialoglar tuzing.
exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI MISOLLAR:

  SA: How MUCH milk do you need?
  SB: Just a LITTLE.

  SA: How MANY carrots do you need?
  SB: Just a FEW.

TO'LDIRILADIGAN QOIDALAR:
  We use ...... and ...... with UNCOUNTABLE nouns.
  We use ...... and ...... with COUNTABLE nouns.

ASOSIY JADVAL:

  SANALMAYDIGAN (milk, bread, flour)
     savol:  HOW MUCH ...?
     javob:  A LITTLE  (bir oz)

  SANALADIGAN (carrots, eggs, bananas)
     savol:  HOW MANY ...?
     javob:  A FEW  (bir nechta)

ESLATMA — ESLAB QOLISH USULI:
  MANY va FEW — ikkalasida ham SANALADIGAN otlar
  MUCH va LITTLE — ikkalasida ham SANALMAYDIGAN otlar

DIQQAT: 'just' = shunchaki, atigi — javobni yumshatadi.

items.textEn: We use ............ and ............ with uncountable nouns.
items.whyUz:
SANALMAYDIGAN otlar bilan HOW MUCH va A LITTLE.
Misol: How MUCH milk do you need? — Just a LITTLE.
Boshqa misollar: how much bread, how much sugar, a little water.

items.textEn: We use ............ and ............ with countable nouns.
items.whyUz:
SANALADIGAN otlar bilan HOW MANY va A FEW.
Misol: How MANY carrots do you need? — Just a FEW.
Boshqa misollar: how many eggs, how many bananas, a few onions.

exercises.instructionEn: Then use the prompts to act out similar dialogues.
exercises.instructionUz: So'ng berilgan so'zlar bilan shunga o'xshash dialoglar tuzing.
exercises.explanationUz:
BERILGAN SO'ZLAR (11 ta):
  ham, onions, flour, peppers, tomatoes, olives,
  bacon, cheese, bread, bananas, coconuts

AVVAL HAR BIR SO'ZNI GURUHLANG:

  SANALMAYDIGAN (5 ta) → HOW MUCH ... ? — Just a little.
     ham, flour, bacon, cheese, bread

  SANALADIGAN (6 ta) → HOW MANY ... ? — Just a few.
     onions, peppers, tomatoes, olives, bananas, coconuts

DIQQAT: sanaladigan otlar ro'yxatda ALLAQACHON KO'PLIKDA
berilgan — bu ularning sanalishini ko'rsatadi.

items.question: How much ham do you need?
items.whyUz:
'ham' — SANALMAYDIGAN (massa) → HOW MUCH + A LITTLE.
Sanash uchun: 'a slice of ham'.

items.question: How many onions do you need?
items.whyUz: 'onions' — SANALADIGAN → HOW MANY + A FEW.

items.question: How much flour do you need?
items.whyUz:
'flour' (un) — kukun → SANALMAYDIGAN → HOW MUCH.
Sanash uchun: 'a packet of flour', 'a kilo of flour'.

items.question: How many peppers do you need?
items.whyUz:
'peppers' bu yerda — bulg'or qalampiri (sabzavot) → SANALADIGAN.
DIQQAT: 'pepper' (qora qalampir, ziravor) SANALMAYDI.

items.question: How many tomatoes do you need?
items.whyUz:
'tomatoes' — SANALADIGAN → HOW MANY.
Ko'pligi: tomato → tomatoES.

items.question: How many olives do you need?
items.whyUz:
'olives' (zaytun) — SANALADIGAN → HOW MANY.
DIQQAT: 'olive oil' (zaytun moyi) esa SANALMAYDI.

items.question: How much bacon do you need?
items.whyUz:
'bacon' — SANALMAYDIGAN (massa) → HOW MUCH.
Sanash uchun: 'a slice of bacon'.

items.question: How much cheese do you need?
items.whyUz:
'cheese' — SANALMAYDIGAN → HOW MUCH.
Sanash uchun: 'a piece of cheese', 'a kilo of cheese'.

items.question: How much bread do you need?
items.whyUz:
'bread' — SANALMAYDIGAN → HOW MUCH.
Sanash uchun: 'a loaf of bread', 'a slice of bread'.

items.question: How many bananas do you need?
items.whyUz: 'bananas' — SANALADIGAN → HOW MANY.

items.question: How many coconuts do you need?
items.whyUz:
'coconuts' — SANALADIGAN → HOW MANY.
DIQQAT: 'coconut milk' (kokos suti) esa SANALMAYDI.

exercises.instructionEn: Julie is making a shopping list for a dinner party. Look at the shopping list, then listen and tick the things she needs and cross out the things she doesn't need. Finally, ask and answer questions, as in the example.
exercises.instructionUz: Juli ziyofat uchun xarid ro'yxatini tuzayapti. Xarid ro'yxatiga qarang, so'ng tinglang va unga kerak bo'lgan narsalarni belgilang, kerak bo'lmaganlarini chizib tashlang. Nihoyat, namunadagidek savol-javob qiling.
exercises.audioRequiredUz: Qaysi band belgilanishi (✓) va qaysisi chizib tashlanishi faqat kassetada aniqlanadi. Kitobda ikkitasi BERILGAN: '2 kilos of meat' ✓ va '10 eggs' chizib tashlangan. Qolgan bandlar uchun quyida savol qolipi berilgan.
exercises.explanationUz:
XARID RO'YXATI (Shopping List):
  2 kilos of meat  ✓ (kerak — kitobda belgilangan)
  10 eggs          ✗ (kerak emas — kitobda chizib tashlangan)
  1 kilo of cheese
  20 slices of ham
  2 loaves of bread
  1 kilo of tomatoes
  2 packets of flour
  3 bottles of Coke
  1 carton of orange juice
  8 bananas

KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:
  S1: How MUCH meat does she need?
  S2: She needs two kilos of meat. How MANY eggs does she need?
  S3: She doesn't need any eggs. ...

SAVOL QOLIPI:
  SANALMAYDIGAN → How MUCH ... does she need?
     meat, cheese, ham, bread, flour, Coke, orange juice
  SANALADIGAN → How MANY ... does she need?
     tomatoes, bananas, eggs

JAVOB QOLIPI:
  KERAK bo'lsa:     She needs + miqdor + of + ot.
  KERAK EMAS bo'lsa: She doesn't need ANY + ot.

DIQQAT — INKORDA 'ANY':
  She doesn't need ANY eggs.
  ('She doesn't need some eggs' XATO)

DIQQAT — 'tomatoes' BILAN 'How MANY':
  Ro'yxatda '1 kilo of tomatoes' deyilgan bo'lsa ham,
  'tomatoes' o'zi SANALADIGAN ot → How MANY tomatoes?
  Yoki miqdorga qarab: How MUCH is a kilo of tomatoes?

items.question: How much meat does she need?
items.answer: She needs two kilos of meat.
items.whyUz:
Kitobda BERILGAN namuna.
'meat' — SANALMAYDIGAN → HOW MUCH.

items.question: How many eggs does she need?
items.whyUz:
Kitobda BERILGAN namuna.
'eggs' — SANALADIGAN → HOW MANY.
Inkorda ANY: 'doesn't need ANY eggs'.

items.question: How much cheese does she need?
items.answer: She needs one kilo of cheese.
items.whyUz:
'cheese' — SANALMAYDIGAN → HOW MUCH.
Agar audioda chizib tashlansa: 'She doesn't need any cheese.'

items.question: How much ham does she need?
items.answer: She needs twenty slices of ham.
items.whyUz:
'ham' — SANALMAYDIGAN → HOW MUCH.
'20 slices of ham' = yigirma bo'lak vetchina.

items.question: How much bread does she need?
items.answer: She needs two loaves of bread.
items.whyUz:
'bread' — SANALMAYDIGAN → HOW MUCH.
'loaves' — 'loaf' ning ko'pligi (-f → -VES, 56-bet).

items.question: How many tomatoes does she need?
items.answer: She needs one kilo of tomatoes.
items.whyUz:
'tomatoes' — SANALADIGAN → HOW MANY.
Miqdori kilo bilan berilgan bo'lsa ham, ot sanaladi.

items.question: How much flour does she need?
items.answer: She needs two packets of flour.
items.whyUz:
'flour' — SANALMAYDIGAN → HOW MUCH.
'2 packets of flour' = ikki paket un.

items.question: How much Coke does she need?
items.answer: She needs three bottles of Coke.
items.whyUz:
'Coke' — SANALMAYDIGAN (suyuqlik) → HOW MUCH.
'3 bottles of Coke' = uch shisha kola.

items.question: How much orange juice does she need?
items.answer: She needs one carton of orange juice.
items.whyUz:
'orange juice' — SANALMAYDIGAN → HOW MUCH.
'a carton' = qog'oz paket.

items.question: How many bananas does she need?
items.whyUz:
'bananas' — SANALADIGAN → HOW MANY.
Miqdor so'zi kerak emas — to'g'ridan-to'g'ri son.

exercises.instructionEn: Study the dialogue below and complete the rules.
exercises.instructionUz: Quyidagi dialogni o'rganing va qoidalarni to'ldiring.
exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI DIALOG:

  SA: Is there ANY milk in the fridge?
  SB: No, I'm afraid there isn't ANY milk.
      Would you like SOME Coke instead?
  SA: Yes, please. I'd love SOME.
      Can I have SOME ice too?
  SB: Yes, of course.

O'ZBEKCHA TARJIMASI:
  SA: Muzlatgichda sut bormi?
  SB: Yo'q, afsuski sut yo'q. Uning o'rniga kola xohlaysizmi?
  SA: Ha, iltimos. Juda xohlardim. Muz ham olsam bo'ladimi?
  SB: Ha, albatta.

TO'LDIRILADIGAN QOIDALAR:
  We use SOME in the affirmative. We also use ......
  in the interrogative form for OFFERS or REQUESTS.
  We use ...... in the negative and interrogative form.

ASOSIY QOIDA:

  SOME →  TASDIQ gapda
            There is some milk.
          + SAVOLDA, agar TAKLIF yoki ILTIMOS bo'lsa
            Would you like SOME Coke?   (taklif)
            Can I have SOME ice?        (iltimos)

  ANY  →  INKOR gapda
            There isn't ANY milk.
          + oddiy SAVOLDA (ma'lumot so'raganda)
            Is there ANY milk in the fridge?

DIQQAT — 'I'm afraid' = afsuski (yomon xabarni yumshatadi).
DIQQAT — 'instead' = o'rniga (gap oxirida turadi).

items.textEn: We use some in the affirmative. We also use ............ in the interrogative form for offers or requests.
items.hintUz: Dialogda 'Would you like ...?' va 'Can I have ...?' da qaysi so'z bor?
items.whyUz:
TAKLIF va ILTIMOS savollarida ham SOME ishlatiladi:
  Would you like SOME Coke?  (taklif — offer)
  Can I have SOME ice?       (iltimos — request)
Sababi: bu savollarda javob 'ha' bo'lishi kutiladi.

items.textEn: We use ............ in the negative and interrogative form.
items.hintUz: Dialogda 'Is there ...?' va 'there isn't ...' da qaysi so'z bor?
items.whyUz:
INKOR va oddiy SAVOLDA ANY:
  There ISN'T any milk.        (inkor)
  IS there any milk?           (ma'lumot so'rash)
'There isn't some milk' XATO.

exercises.instructionEn: Say which question expresses an offer and which expresses a request.
exercises.instructionUz: Qaysi savol taklif, qaysisi iltimos ifodalashini ayting.
exercises.explanationUz:
IKKI TUSHUNCHA:

  AN OFFER (taklif) — SIZ boshqaga biror narsa taklif qilasiz
     Would you like some Coke?
     Would you like a cup of tea?
     Shall I help you?

  A REQUEST (iltimos) — SIZ boshqadan biror narsa so'raysiz
     Can I have some ice?
     Could I have some water, please?
     May I use your phone?

ESLAB QOLISH:
  'Would YOU like ...?'  → sizga TAKLIF qilinyapti
  'Can I have ...?'      → siz SO'rayapsiz

items.textEn: Would you like some Coke instead?
items.whyUz:
'Would YOU like ...?' — gapiruvchi boshqaga narsa TAKLIF qilyapti.
Bu — OFFER (taklif).

items.textEn: Can I have some ice too?
items.whyUz:
'Can I have ...?' — gapiruvchi o'ziga narsa SO'rayapti.
Bu — REQUEST (iltimos).

items.textEn: Is there any milk in the fridge?
items.whyUz:
Bu — na taklif, na iltimos; shunchaki MA'LUMOT so'rash.
Shuning uchun ANY ishlatiladi ('some' emas).

exercises.instructionEn: Use the prompts to act out similar dialogues.
exercises.instructionUz: Berilgan so'zlar bilan shunga o'xshash dialoglar tuzing.
exercises.explanationUz:
BERILGAN SO'ZLAR (uch guruh, har birida 3 ta so'z):
  orange juice - coffee - biscuits
  cheese - ham - bread
  bananas - strawberries - sugar

DIALOG QOLIPI (dialogdagi kabi):
  SA: Is there any [1-so'z] in the fridge?
  SB: No, I'm afraid there isn't any [1-so'z].
      Would you like some [2-so'z] instead?
  SA: Yes, please. I'd love some.
      Can I have some [3-so'z] too?
  SB: Yes, of course.

DIQQAT — SANALADIGAN OTLAR:
  'biscuits', 'bananas', 'strawberries' — KO'PLIK.
  Savolda: 'Is there any ...?' → 'ARE there any ...?'
  Ko'plik ot bilan 'are' ishlatiladi.

items.question: Is there any orange juice in the fridge?
items.answer: No, I'm afraid there isn't any orange juice. Would you like some coffee instead? — Yes, please. I'd love some. Can I have some biscuits too? — Yes, of course.
items.whyUz:
'orange juice' va 'coffee' — SANALMAYDIGAN → 'Is there any ...?'
'biscuits' — KO'PLIK, lekin ILTIMOS savolida SOME.

items.question: Is there any cheese in the fridge?
items.answer: No, I'm afraid there isn't any cheese. Would you like some ham instead? — Yes, please. I'd love some. Can I have some bread too? — Yes, of course.
items.whyUz:
Uchalasi ham SANALMAYDIGAN → 'Is there any ...?'
Inkorda ANY, taklif va iltimosda SOME.

items.question: Are there any bananas in the fridge?
items.answer: No, I'm afraid there aren't any bananas. Would you like some strawberries instead? — Yes, please. I'd love some. Can I have some sugar too? — Yes, of course.
items.whyUz:
'bananas' — KO'PLIK → 'ARE there any ...?' va 'there AREN'T any'.
'sugar' — SANALMAYDIGAN → 'some sugar'.

sections.title: Accepting and refusing offers
sections.titleUz: Taklifni qabul qilish va rad etish

exercises.instructionEn: Listen to the dialogue and fill in the missing words.
exercises.instructionUz: Dialogni tinglang va tushib qolgan so'zlarni qo'ying.
exercises.explanationUz:
RASMDA: kamin oldida o'tirgan yigit va qiz.
To'rtta nutq pufakchasi bor.

DIALOG (to'ldirilgan holda):
  — Would you like some coffee?
  — Yes, PLEASE. I'd love some.
  — Would you like some cake?
  — No, THANKS. I don't like cakes.

O'ZBEKCHA TARJIMASI:
  — Qahva xohlaysizmi?
  — Ha, iltimos. Juda xohlardim.
  — Tort xohlaysizmi?
  — Yo'q, rahmat. Men tortni yoqtirmayman.

IKKI JAVOB SHAKLI:
  QABUL QILISH: Yes, please. I'd love some.
  RAD ETISH:    No, thanks. I don't like ...

DIQQAT: rad etishda SABAB aytiladi — bu muloyimlik belgisi.

lines.whyUz:
'Yes, PLEASE.' — taklifni QABUL QILISH.
'Yes, thanks' — bu kontekstda g'alati eshitiladi.

'No, THANKS.' — taklifni muloyim RAD ETISH.
'No, thank you' ham to'g'ri (rasmiyroq).
DIQQAT: 'No, please' XATO.

exercises.instructionEn: Say what the speaker says to accept the offer and what he says to refuse the offer.
exercises.instructionUz: Gapiruvchi taklifni qabul qilish uchun nima deyishini va rad etish uchun nima deyishini ayting.
exercises.explanationUz:
TAKLIFGA IKKI XIL JAVOB:

  QABUL QILISH (to accept):
     Yes, please.
     Yes, please. I'd love some.
     Oh, yes, please!
     That would be nice, thank you.

  RAD ETISH (to refuse):
     No, thanks.
     No, thank you.
     No, thanks. I don't like ...
     No, thanks. I'm not hungry/thirsty.

DIQQAT — ENG MUHIM FARQ:
  QABUL → PLEASE
  RAD   → THANKS / THANK YOU

O'zbekchada 'rahmat' ikkalasida ham ishlatiladi,
ingliz tilida esa YO'Q — farqi aniq.

items.textEn: Taklifni QABUL QILISH uchun nima deydi?
options: No, thanks. I don't like cakes.
items.whyUz:
QABUL QILISH: 'Yes, PLEASE.'
'I'd love some' = juda xohlardim (kuchli qabul).
'I'd' = I would.

items.textEn: Taklifni RAD ETISH uchun nima deydi?
options: No, thanks. I don't like cakes.
items.answer: No, thanks. I don't like cakes.
items.whyUz:
RAD ETISH: 'No, THANKS.'
So'ng SABAB aytiladi — bu muloyimlik belgisi.

exercises.instructionEn: Use the prompts to act out similar dialogues.
exercises.instructionUz: Berilgan so'zlar bilan shunga o'xshash dialoglar tuzing.
exercises.explanationUz:
BERILGAN SO'ZLAR (to'rt juftlik):
  orange juice, chocolate
  milk, biscuits
  wine, chips
  lemon juice, cherries

QOLIP:
  — Would you like some [1-so'z]?
  — Yes, please. I'd love some.
  — Would you like some [2-so'z]?
  — No, thanks. I don't like [2-so'z].

DIQQAT — RAD ETISHDA OT SHAKLI:
  SANALMAYDIGAN → I don't like chocolate.
  KO'PLIK        → I don't like biscuits.
  Umumiy yoqtirmaslikni bildirganda KO'PLIK ishlatiladi.

items.question: Would you like some orange juice? — Would you like some chocolate?
items.answer: Yes, please. I'd love some. — No, thanks. I don't like chocolate.
items.whyUz:
Ikkalasi ham SANALMAYDIGAN → SOME bilan.
'chocolate' — sanalmaydigan (massa).

items.question: Would you like some milk? — Would you like some biscuits?
items.answer: Yes, please. I'd love some. — No, thanks. I don't like biscuits.
items.whyUz:
'milk' — sanalmaydigan; 'biscuits' — ko'plik.
Ikkalasi ham taklif savolida SOME bilan.

items.question: Would you like some wine? — Would you like some chips?
items.answer: Yes, please. I'd love some. — No, thanks. I don't like chips.
items.whyUz: 'wine' — sanalmaydigan; 'chips' — ko'plik (kartoshka fri).

items.question: Would you like some lemon juice? — Would you like some cherries?
items.answer: Yes, please. I'd love some. — No, thanks. I don't like cherries.
items.whyUz:
'lemon juice' — sanalmaydigan; 'cherries' — ko'plik.
'cherry' → 'cherries' (undosh + y → -IES).

exercises.explanationUz:
BU MASHQ — BUTUN BETNING TAKRORI.

XATO TURLARI:

  1) SOME / A / AN noto'g'ri ishlatilgan
       some banana → A banana (sanaladigan birlik)
       a water → SOME water (sanalmaydigan)

  2) SOME / ANY noto'g'ri
       Can I have ANY bread? → SOME (iltimos savoli)

  3) 'I like' o'rniga 'I'd like' kerak
       'I like' = yoqtiraman (umuman)
       'I'd like' = xohlayman (hozir)

  4) HOW MUCH / HOW MANY noto'g'ri
       How many honey? → How MUCH (sanalmaydigan)
       How much oranges? → How MANY (sanaladigan)

  5) A FEW / A LITTLE noto'g'ri
       milk uchun 'a few' → A LITTLE

  6) Sanalmaydigan otga -s qo'shilgan
       some sugars → some SUGAR

KITOBDA BERILGAN: 1-band ('some' chizib tashlangan, 'a' yozilgan).

items.textEn: 1  I'd like some banana please. → ............
items.whyUz:
Kitobda BERILGAN javob: 'some' → 'a'.
'a banana' — SANALADIGAN BIRLIK → 'a' kerak.
To'g'ri gap: I'd like A banana, please.

items.textEn: 2  I'm thirsty. I'd like a water. → ............
items.whyUz:
'water' — SANALMAYDIGAN → 'a' ISHLATILMAYDI.
To'g'ri gap: I'd like SOME water.
(Yoki: 'a glass of water'.)

items.textEn: 3  Can I have any bread, please? → ............
items.whyUz:
ILTIMOS (request) savolida SOME ishlatiladi.
To'g'ri gap: Can I have SOME bread, please?
13-mashqdagi qoida.

items.textEn: 4  I'm hungry. I like a hamburger. → ............
items.whyUz:
'I like' = umuman yoqtiraman.
'I'd like' (= I WOULD like) = hozir xohlayman.
Qorni ochgan odam 'I'D LIKE a hamburger' deydi.

items.textEn: 5  Would you like some tea? Yes, I love some. → ............
items.whyUz:
'I love some' — noto'g'ri.
To'g'ri: 'Yes, I'D LOVE some.' (= I WOULD love)
Taklifga javobda DOIM 'I'd love' ishlatiladi.

items.textEn: 6  Do you like a cup of tea? Yes, please. → ............
items.whyUz:
'Yes, please' — TAKLIFGA javob, shuning uchun savol ham
taklif bo'lishi kerak: 'WOULD YOU LIKE a cup of tea?'
'Do you like tea?' savoliga javob 'Yes, I do' bo'lardi.

items.textEn: 7  I'd like some sugars in my tea. → ............
items.whyUz:
'sugar' — SANALMAYDIGAN → -S QO'SHILMAYDI.
To'g'ri gap: I'd like some SUGAR in my tea.

items.textEn: 8  How many honey do you need? → ............
items.whyUz:
'honey' (asal) — SANALMAYDIGAN → HOW MUCH.
To'g'ri gap: HOW MUCH honey do you need?

items.textEn: 9  Could I have a butter please? → ............
items.whyUz:
'butter' — SANALMAYDIGAN → 'a' ISHLATILMAYDI.
To'g'ri gap: Could I have SOME butter, please?
('Could I have ...?' — 'Can I have ...?' dan muloyimroq.)

items.textEn: 10  "Would you like some milk in your tea?" "Just a few, please." → ............
items.whyUz:
'milk' — SANALMAYDIGAN → A LITTLE ('a few' XATO).
To'g'ri javob: 'Just A LITTLE, please.'
11-mashqdagi qoida.

items.textEn: 11  I'd like eggs but I don't like bacon. → ............
items.hintUz: Tasdiq gapda qaysi so'z tushib qolgan?
items.whyUz:
TASDIQ gapda ko'plik ot oldida SOME kerak.
To'g'ri gap: I'd like SOME EGGS but I don't like bacon.
DIQQAT: inkorda ('I don't like bacon') 'some' KERAK EMAS.

items.textEn: 12  How many wine is there in the fridge? → ............
items.whyUz:
'wine' — SANALMAYDIGAN → HOW MUCH.
To'g'ri gap: HOW MUCH wine is there in the fridge?
(Fe'l 'is' ham sanalmaydigan otga ishora qiladi.)

items.textEn: 13  How much oranges do we need? → ............
items.whyUz:
'oranges' — SANALADIGAN, KO'PLIKDA → HOW MANY.
To'g'ri gap: HOW MANY oranges do we need?
12-band bilan solishtiring — teskari xato.

groups.explanationUz: Har bir so'z faqat bir turdagi ot bilan ishlatiladi.
Gap turiga va maqsadiga qarab tanlanadi.
Kim kimga narsa taklif qilyapti — shunga qarab shakl tanlanadi.
PLEASE — qabul, THANKS — rad. Bu farqni yodda tuting.

patterns.formula: How MUCH + sanalmaydigan + do you need? — Just a LITTLE.
patterns.exampleEn: How much milk do you need? — Just a little.
patterns.exampleUz: Sizga qancha sut kerak? — Bir oz.
patterns.explanationUz: MUCH va LITTLE — ikkalasi ham SANALMAYDIGAN otlar bilan.

patterns.formula: How MANY + sanaladigan (ko'plik) + do you need? — Just a FEW.
patterns.exampleEn: How many carrots do you need? — Just a few.
patterns.exampleUz: Sizga nechta sabzi kerak? — Bir nechta.
patterns.explanationUz: MANY va FEW — ikkalasi ham SANALADIGAN otlar bilan.

patterns.formula: She needs + miqdor + OF + ot.  /  She doesn't need ANY + ot.
patterns.exampleEn: She needs two kilos of meat. She doesn't need any eggs.
patterns.exampleUz: Unga ikki kilo go'sht kerak. Unga tuxum kerak emas.
patterns.explanationUz: INKORDA doim ANY: 'doesn't need ANY eggs'.

patterns.formula: Is/Are there ANY ...? — No, there isn't/aren't ANY ...
patterns.exampleEn: Is there any milk in the fridge? — No, I'm afraid there isn't any milk.
patterns.exampleUz: Muzlatgichda sut bormi? — Yo'q, afsuski sut yo'q.
patterns.explanationUz: Ma'lumot so'rash savolida va inkorda ANY.

patterns.formula: Would you like SOME ...? (taklif)  /  Can I have SOME ...? (iltimos)
patterns.exampleEn: Would you like some Coke? Can I have some ice too?
patterns.exampleUz: Kola xohlaysizmi? Muz ham olsam bo'ladimi?
patterns.explanationUz: TAKLIF va ILTIMOS savollarida SOME (any EMAS).

patterns.formula: Yes, PLEASE. I'd love some.  /  No, THANKS. I don't like ...
patterns.exampleEn: Yes, please. I'd love some. — No, thanks. I don't like cakes.
patterns.exampleUz: Ha, iltimos. Juda xohlardim. — Yo'q, rahmat. Men tortni yoqtirmayman.
patterns.explanationUz:
QABUL → PLEASE.  RAD → THANKS.
Rad etganda SABAB aytish — muloyimlik belgisi.

patterns.exampleEn: I'd like a banana, please. I'd like some water, please.
patterns.exampleUz: Menga banan bering, iltimos. Menga suv bering, iltimos.
patterns.explanationUz:
SANALADIGAN BIRLIK → A.  SANALMAYDIGAN → SOME.
'I like' EMAS, 'I'D like' (= I would like).
